description: Host header injection — abuse a trusted Host/X-Forwarded-Host to poison password-reset links, routing, and caches. Load when the app builds absolute URLs from the request host, on password-reset flows, or behind a proxy/CDN. Signals: reset emails with links, X-Forwarded-Host reflected, virtual hosting, cache in front.
